motion.name: marketing-rise
motion.purpose: A staggered public hero entrance that leaves content visible when motion is unavailable.

motion.name: trace-travel
motion.purpose: Moves architecture signals along the request schematic while it is visible.

motion.name: marquee
motion.purpose: Scrolls the public technology stack; the visitor can pause it and reduced motion disables it.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Settles trace-node fill and stroke changes and ordinary public state changes.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Removes entrance, trace, and transition motion and pauses WebGL and GSAP animation.

components.name: Primary button
components.description: The single main action in a region, such as opening the live demo.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 36px; gap: 6px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radius-md, 6px); background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); font: 500 0.875rem/1.25 'Geist Variable', ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; transition: background-color 180ms ease, outline-color 180ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--primary) 80%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline button
components.description: A quieter action that keeps a visible edge against the dark scheme.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 36px; gap: 6px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--input); border-radius: var(--radius-md, 6px); background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--input) 30%, transparent); color: var(--foreground); font: 500 0.875rem/1.25 'Geist Variable', ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; transition: background-color 180ms ease, color 180ms ease, outline-color 180ms ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--input) 50%, transparent); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text input
components.description: A compact search or form field with a distinct control edge.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; color: var(--muted-foreground); font: 400 0.75rem/1.25 'Geist Mono Variable', ui-monospace, monospace; } .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--input); border-radius: var(--radius-md, 6px); background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--input) 30%, transparent); color: var(--foreground); font: 400 0.875rem/1.25 'Geist Variable', ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; outline: none; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--muted-foreground); } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--ring); outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Public navigation
components.description: The desktop site links sit in one centered pill inside the sticky public header.
components.html: DemoDocsPricing
components.css: .ds-public-nav { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 4px 8px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--card); } .ds-nav-link { padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: var(--radius-md, 6px); color: var(--muted-foreground); font: 400 0.875rem/1.25 'Geist Variable', ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 180ms ease, color 180ms ease; } .ds-nav-link:hover, .ds-nav-link-active { background: var(--muted); color: var(--foreground); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Proof card
components.description: A linked repository or Reference Application proof card in the public bento.
components.html: packages/capabilitiesShared application behaviorThe same capability layer serves every interface.
components.css: .ds-proof-card { display: flex; min-height: 256px; flex-direction: column; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; padding: 24px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 0; background: var(--card); color: var(--foreground); text-decoration: none; transition: border-color 180ms ease, background-color 180ms ease; } .ds-proof-card:hover { border-color: var(--primary); background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--muted) 40%, var(--card)); } .ds-proof-card:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-proof-path { color: var(--muted-foreground); font: 400 0.75rem/1.25 'Geist Mono Variable', ui-monospace, monospace; } .ds-proof-card strong { font: 600 1.25rem/1.25 'Geist Variable', ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; } .ds-proof-copy { color: var(--muted-foreground); font: 400 0.875rem/1.5 'Geist Variable', ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; }

components.name: Provider disclosure
components.description: An honest environment-gated provider panel that expands without inventing activity.
components.html:
Stripe +

Optional provider. It stays inactive until configured.

Read provider docs
components.css: .ds-provider { border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 0; background: var(--card); color: var(--foreground); } .ds-provider summary { display: flex; min-height: 80px; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 24px 20px; cursor: pointer; list-style: none; font: 500 0.875rem/1.25 'Geist Variable', ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; } .ds-provider summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; } .ds-provider p, .ds-provider a { display: block; margin: 0 20px 24px; color: var(--muted-foreground); font: 400 0.875rem/1.5 'Geist Variable', ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; } .ds-provider a { color: var(--foreground); text-decoration: underline; } .ds-provider summary:focus-visible, .ds-provider a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Trace tabs
components.description: A four-stage request trace that keeps one code or runtime view readable at a time.
components.css: .ds-trace-tabs { display: flex; gap: 4px; overflow-x: auto; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); } .ds-trace-tab { min-height: 44px; flex: 0 0 auto; padding: 12px 16px; border: 0; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; background: transparent; color: var(--muted-foreground); font: 400 0.875rem/1.25 'Geist Variable', ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-trace-tab:hover, .ds-trace-tab-active { color: var(--foreground); } .ds-trace-tab-active { border-bottom-color: var(--primary); } .ds-trace-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: -2px; }
